First release of **Overview**, a GNOME-style Activities overview for Windows 10/11.

## Download
- **`Overview-Setup.exe`**: the installer. Choose *Start with Windows*, *Check for updates automatically* and *Desktop shortcut*. Installs for your user only, no admin needed.
- **`Overview-standalone.exe`**: the same app without installing. Run it from anywhere. It never checks for updates.

Windows SmartScreen may warn because the exe isn't code-signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**.

## What's in it
- Tap the Windows key to see every open window as a live thumbnail grid, and tap again to switch to the highlighted window. Double-tap jumps back to your previous window, like Alt+Tab.
- Search open windows and installed apps, with fuzzy matching.
- Web search in your default browser, with suggestions while you type.
- An app grid with every installed app.
- Right-click menus: run as administrator, open file location, properties, new window, end task.
- Backspace closes the selected window; Del force-closes it.
- The taskbar stays visible, including when it's set to auto-hide.
- Automatic updates from this page, if you choose them during setup.
